dimensions.detail: External requests to YouTube and optional transcript-derived data sharing with OpenAI are proportionate for video summarization and are documented, with simple/transcript modes available for sensitive content.
dimensions.label: Credentials

dimensions.detail: It requires a preinstalled pinned youtube2md CLI and optionally @openai/codex-sdk; runtime npx is not supported and command override via YOUTUBE2MD_BIN is rejected.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill explicitly treats messages containing only YouTube URLs as summary requests; this is broad but disclosed and directly related to the skill purpose.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The runner writes disclosed local output artifacts under ./summaries or user-provided paths; no hidden persistence, privilege escalation, or background worker behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The capabilities fit the stated purpose: it accepts YouTube URLs, extracts captions/transcripts, optionally summarizes through youtube2md providers, and returns summaries or transcripts.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The bare-URL trigger is real and broad, but it is stated in the description and workflow and remains within the purpose of summarizing user-provided YouTube links.
[SQP-1] expected: Automatic handling of URL-only messages can cause network fetching and possible provider use, but provider data exposure and fallback modes are disclosed rather than hidden.
[SQP-3] expected: Korean output guidance is a presentation preference for matching Korean videos or user requests, not a security-significant override or unrelated behavior.
llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with a local youtube2md CLI processing YouTube links. For sensitive videos, use simple or transcript mode and avoid enabling OpenAI/Codex provider paths or YouTube cookies unless you understand that transcript, audio-derived content, or signed-in YouTube context may be exposed to those runtimes.
llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed YouTube summarization helper with expected network, transcript, and optional OpenAI/Codex provider use, though users should be aware of URL-only activation and credential-related options.
